item.title: [IGNITE-2065] Need to get rid of 'Portable' word in internals
item.description: Currently there is a bunch of objects that were kept from Portable objects migration, such as PortableContext and portable package. Need to rename them to Binary*.
item.summary: Need to get rid of 'Portable' word in internals

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: Artem, please take a look, I think we should not have word 'portable' in ignite (need also check javadoc).
Note. Should keepPortable flage be changed for cpp and .Net?
